lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance nodes are arranged in approximately 10 distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with each column containing 3 to 5 primary circular clusters of local maxima intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The circular high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersections of vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal planes, forming a consistent grid-like geometric matrix across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast, high-luminance clusters localized within the visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) silhouette adjacent to the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin; white alphanumeric characters '©Ningaloo Discovery - Windcheetah' present in the lower-right quadrant.
